channel.description: Newest perfume decant arrivals at Decantified

item.title: Supreme Black by Amar Parfums – Sample Decant
item.description:
Vendor: Amar Parfums
Type:
Price: 1.99 - 20.00 (5 variants)

Overview

Supreme Black Pour Homme by Amar Parfums is a sweet, spicy-woody Eau de Parfum for men. Roasted pineapple and blood orange open with a cardamom spark, then a rich vanilla and coconut heart, lifted by clary sage, melts into ebony wood, patchouli and tonka. A warm, sweet evening scent, often compared to Rabanne 1 Million Black.

Fragrance Notes

Top: Roasted Pineapple, Blood Orange, Cardamom
Middle: Vanilla Accord, Coconut Accord, Clary Sage
Base: Ebony Wood Accord, Patchouli, Tonka Bean

Best for

Season: Fall and winter · Wear it: date night, nights out, special occasions · For: him

item.title: Borouj Mysterious by Dumont – Sample Decant
item.description:
Vendor: Dumont
Type:
Price: 2.49 - 21.09 (5 variants)

Overview

Borouj Mysterious by Dumont is an Eau de Parfum that opens bright and juicy with bergamot, green notes and sugar cane, before melon, pineapple and jasmine add a sweet, fruity glow over a powdery amber-vanilla trail. A smooth, sweet-woody unisex scent, often compared to Xerjoff Erba Pura.

The dry-down settles into soft vanilla, white musk, cedar and moss, warm and easy to wear from spring days into fall evenings.

Fragrance Notes

Top: Amber, Bergamot, Green Notes, Sugar Cane
Middle: Melon, Pineapple, Jasmine, Cedar, Gourmand Accord, Mineral Notes
Base: Amber, Vanilla, White Musk, Cedar, Woody Notes, Moss

Best for

Season: Spring, summer and fall · Wear it: date night, nights out · For: him and her

item.title: Game of Spades Full House Extrait by Jo Milano – Sample Decant
item.description:
Vendor: Jo Milano
Type:
Price: 2.99 - 25.00 (5 variants)

Overview

Game of Spades Full House Extrait is the richer, more concentrated version of Jo Milano's Full House: an Extrait de Parfum that pairs sparkling citrus with a warm ginger-cinnamon heart and a smooth black tea, guaiac wood and incense dry-down. It's bright and polished up top, then settles into a longer, deeper trail than the original, often compared to Louis Vuitton Imagination.

A unisex scent that wears clean and refined, easy to reach for on any day you want to smell put-together.

Fragrance Notes

Top: Citron, Calabrian Bergamot, Sicilian Orange
Middle: Tunisian Neroli, Nigerian Ginger, Ceylon Cinnamon
Base: Chinese Black Tea, Ambroxan, Guaiac Wood, Olibanum

Best for

Season: Spring and summer · Wear it: office, everyday · Performance: long-lasting

item.description:
Vendor: Armaf
Type:
Price: 2.49 - 21.09 (5 variants)

Overview

Effects of Uniq is a sweet, warm gourmand Eau de Parfum from Armaf's Uniq line. Juicy pear and mandarin lead into creamy orange blossom and vanilla. It settles into a dark, cosy base of coffee, caramel, cedar and patchouli, often compared to Yves Saint Laurent Black Opium Le Parfum.

Fragrance Notes

Top: Pear, Mandarin
Middle: Orange Blossom, Vanilla
Base: Coffee, Caramel, Cedarwood, Patchouli, White Musk

Best for

Season: Fall and winter · Wear it: date night, night out · Performance: long-lasting

item.title: Game of Spades Face Card by Jo Milano – Sample Decant
item.description:
Vendor: Jo Milano
Type:
Price: 2.99 - 25.00 (5 variants)

Overview

Game of Spades Face Card is a confident fresh-spicy Extrait de Parfum from Jo Milano's 2026 Game of Spades line. Crisp citron, bergamot and juniper open onto lavender, geranium, nutmeg and cypress, before drying down to a warm woody base of ambrox, patchouli and sandalwood. Fresh, aromatic and polished, with the staying power of an extrait.

Fragrance Notes

Top: Citron, Bergamot, Juniper
Middle: Lavender, Geranium, Nutmeg, Cypress
Base: Ambrox, Patchouli, Sandalwood

Best for

Season: Spring, summer and fall · Wear it: office, date night · Performance: long-lasting

item.description:

Type:

Overview

Palawan is a bright, tropical Eau de Parfum from Rayhaan's 2026 line, made in collaboration with Noel Thomas. Sharp calamansi and grapefruit meet juicy pineapple, softened by orange blossom and fig over a clean bed of sandalwood and white musk. A sunny, easy-wearing scent for warm days.

Fragrance Notes

Top: Calamansi, Grapefruit, Yellow Mandarin, Pineapple
Middle: Orange Blossom, Pomarose, Fig
Base: Sandalwood, White Musk, Dry Amber

Best for

Season: Spring and summer · Wear it: everyday, gym, office · Performance: moderate, daytime-friendly

Overview

Royal Ispahan by Mykonos is a soft, romantic Extrait de Parfum that opens bright and juicy with bergamot, raspberry and lychee over a touch of cotton flower. Violet and a creamy rose-milk accord make up the heart, and vanilla, guaiac wood and amber settle it into a warm, velvety finish. It is a sweet, feminine rose scent often compared to Parfums de Marly Delina Exclusif.

Fragrance Notes

Top: Bergamot, Raspberry, Lychee, Cotton Flower
Middle: Violet, Rose Milk, Soft Woods
Base: Vanilla, Guaiac Wood, Amber

Overview

Dark Secret by Mykonos is a rich, mysterious Extrait de Parfum that opens on juicy black cherry lifted by saffron and bergamot. A warm heart of cinnamon, nutmeg, jasmine and praline follows, and amber, tonka, sandalwood and musk give it a deep, sweet, lingering finish. It is a dark cherry evening scent often compared to Tom Ford Lost Cherry.

Fragrance Notes

Top: Black Cherry, Saffron, Bergamot
Middle: Cinnamon, Nutmeg, Marigold, Jasmine, Praline
Base: Amber, Musk, Tonka Bean, Sandalwood

Paladin is a warm, aromatic vanilla-and-lavender Eau de Parfum, often compared to Valentino Uomo Born in Roma Intense. Smooth vanilla opens straight into a clean, herbal lavender heart, and the drydown turns earthy and slightly smoky with vetiver. Sweet, fresh and quietly powerful.

Middle: Lavender, Aromatic Notes

Hera is a bright, softly sweet fruity-floral Eau de Parfum, often compared to Parfums de Marly Palatine. Juicy pear and mandarin open over a lavender-and-violet heart, then settle into a clean, creamy base of musk, sandalwood and vanilla. An easy, polished unisex scent for everyday wear.

item.title: Dirty Heaven by BORNTOSTANDOUT – Sample Decant
item.description:
Vendor: BORNTOSTANDOUT
Type:
Price: 5.99 - 44.99 (5 variants)

Overview

Dirty Heaven is BORNTOSTANDOUT's luminous white-floral gourmand, an Eau de Parfum from the independent niche house. Bright white flowers open into a heart of jasmine and neroli, then a warm, creamy cloud of tonka bean, vanilla, saffron and ambroxan settles in, with white musks, grey amber and modern woods adding a subtly sensual, skin-like edge. Ethereal and addictive, it is sweet without being simple.

Fragrance Notes

Top: White Flowers
Middle: Jasmine, Neroli
Base: Tonka Bean, Saffron, Ambroxan, Vanilla, White Musks, Grey Amber, Modern Woods

Best for

Season: Spring, fall and winter · Wear it: date night, nights out; day or evening

Try It Before You Commit

No two people wear a scent quite the same way. Try a decant over several wears to get to know it before committing to a full bottle.

Overview

Club de Nuit Timeless is a warm, spiced leather-and-tobacco Eau de Parfum from Armaf, released in 2026. Black pepper, nutmeg, cardamom and hazelnut open it with a toasty, spicy glow, cinnamon, rose and frankincense build a smoky heart, and honeyed tobacco, suede, amber, sandalwood and vanilla give it a rich, dressed-up base. It is a cosy, grown-up scent for cool evenings and dinners out.

Middle: Cinnamon, Rose, Frankincense, Lavender
Base: Tobacco, Suede, Amber, Sandalwood, Vanilla, Akigalawood

Overview

Ghost is a soft, luminous floral-woody Eau de Parfum from Bujairami, inspired by Byredo Mojave Ghost. Creamy sapodilla and musky ambrette open it, a heart of magnolia, violet and sandalwood keeps it airy and gentle, and ambergris and cedar give it a clean, warm-skin finish. Understated and versatile, it is an easy everyday scent that sits close to the skin.

Fragrance Notes

Top: Sapodilla, Ambrette

Base: Ambergris, Cedar

Electric Romance is a playful, fruity Eau de Parfum from Bujairami, inspired by Room 1015 Love-O-Matic. Juicy strawberry, lemon and blackcurrant burst open over an airy, ozonic bubble-gum heart, before it settles into a soft skin of clean musk, ambrette and cedar. V-Luxe is a rich, elegant vanilla Eau de Parfum from Bujairami, inspired by Yves Saint Laurent Libre Vanille Couture. French lavender and orange blossom open it with an airy, clean brightness, a heart of Bourbon vanilla and vanilla caviar brings creamy depth without turning cloying, and a touch of rum in the drydown adds dark, boozy warmth. Polished and quietly addictive, it suits cooler days and evenings out.

Fragrance Notes

Middle: Bourbon Vanilla, Vanilla Caviar

Ivory Kiss is a soft, creamy floral-gourmand Eau de Parfum from Bujairami, inspired by Valentino Born in Roma Donna Ivory. Bright green mandarin opens it, a fluffy heart of orange blossom and marshmallow follows, and it settles into a smooth base of musk and Madagascar vanilla. Sweet, cosy and easy to wear, it is a comforting vanilla with a fresh citrus lift.

item.title: Torino 21 by Xerjoff – Sample Decant
item.description:
Vendor: Xerjoff
Type:
Price: 5.99 - 44.99 (5 variants)

Overview

Torino 21 is Xerjoff's bright, minty citrus niche scent from the Join the Club line, an Eau de Parfum created to celebrate the house's partnership with the ATP Finals tennis tournament in Turin. It opens with a cool rush of spearmint and sharp lemon lifted by basil and thyme, then moves into an aromatic heart of lavender, rosemary, jasmine and a touch of blackcurrant.

It dries down to a clean, airy musk with a soft verbena glow. Fresh, polished and easy to love, it is one of the most popular warm-weather signatures in niche perfumery and lasts well for such a fresh scent.

Fragrance Notes

Top: Mint, Lemon, Basil, Thyme
Middle: Black Currant, Rosemary, Lavender, Jasmine
Base: Musk, Verbena

Best for

Season: Spring and summer · Wear it: office, gym, everyday · Performance: long-lasting, moderate projection

Overview

Terracotta Beige is a soft, powdery woody floral from Jo Milano Paris, an Eau de Parfum often compared to Byredo Mojave Ghost. Musky ambrette and a juicy hint of sapodilla open over a creamy heart of magnolia, violet and sandalwood. The drydown settles into warm ambergris, cedar and clean musk that sits close and elegant on the skin.

Fragrance Notes

Top: Sapodilla, Ambrette
Middle: Magnolia, Violet, Sandalwood
Base: Ambergris, Cedar, Musk

Best for

Season: Spring, summer and fall · Wear it: office, everyday · Performance: soft, close to the skin

item.description:
Vendor: Fragrance World
Type:
Price: 1.99 - 20.00 (5 variants)

Overview

A dark, earthy coffee scent from Fragrance World's Coffee Collection, named after the rare civet coffee of Indonesia. Unsweetened roasted coffee opens over a smoky rose heart, then settles into a resinous base of oud, rockrose and patchouli with a faintly animalic edge. Kopi Luwak is an Eau de Parfum for those who like their coffee scents brooding rather than sugary.

Fragrance Notes

Top: Roasted Coffee
Middle: Rose
Base: Oud, Cistus (Rockrose), Patchouli

Best for

Season: Fall and winter · Wear it: date night, special occasions, evenings

item.description:
Vendor: Maison Asrar
Type:
Price: 2.49 - 49.99 (5 variants)

Overview

Ameer by Maison Asrar is a bright, spicy incense Eau de Parfum. Cardamom, pink pepper, bergamot, saffron and pink grapefruit open fresh and peppery, a heart of frankincense, myrrh, rose, Atlas cedar and lily of the valley turns it resinous and refined, and patchouli, vanilla, moss and musk give it a smooth, long-wearing base. It is an elegant, grown-up scent often compared to Amouage Decision.

Fragrance Notes

Top: Cardamom, Pink Pepper, Bergamot, Saffron, Pink Grapefruit
Middle: Frankincense, Myrrh, Rose, Atlas Cedarwood, Lily of the Valley
Base: Patchouli, Vanilla, Moss, Musk

Season: Fall, winter and spring · Wear it: office, date night, special occasions · Performance: long-lasting

Overview

Pink Drops by Mykonos is a creamy, powdery strawberry-milk gourmand Extrait de Parfum. Strawberry jam, caramel and almond open sweet and edible, a soft milky heart of heliotrope and powdery notes follows, and vanilla and white musk leave a cosy, comforting trail. It is the strawberry sister to Mykonos Milk Drops, sweet and playful without being sharp.

Fragrance Notes

Top: Strawberry Jam, Caramel, Almond
Middle: Milk, Powdery Notes, Heliotrope
Base: Vanilla, White Musk

Best for

Season: Fall, winter and spring · Wear it: date night, office, everyday · Performance: moderate, soft and cosy

Nabatieh by French Avenue is a warm, smoky oriental gourmand Extrait de Parfum. Cardamom, cinnamon and almond open spicy and nutty, a heart of dates, coffee, iris and vanilla brings dark roasted sweetness, and tonka, cedar, Akigalawood and a smoky base give it depth. It is a rich, cosy scent built for cool evenings.

Fragrance Notes

Top: Cardamom, Cinnamon, Almond
Middle: Date, Coffee, Iris, Vanilla
Base: Tonka Bean, Cedarwood, Akigalawood, Smoky Notes

Strawberry, apple, lemon and coconut open juicy and bright, a fluffy marshmallow heart is lifted by orange blossom and jasmine, and vanilla, praline and musk give it a soft, sweet finish. It is a fun, candy-sweet scent often compared to Kayali Yum Boujee Marshmallow 81.

Top: Strawberry, Lemon, Apple, Coconut
Middle: Marshmallow, Orange Blossom, Jasmine
Base: Vanilla, Praline, Musk, Ambroxan

Mayfair by Mykonos is a fruity, floral gourmand Extrait de Parfum with a polished leather-and-woods finish. Bergamot, orange and juicy raspberry open it, a soft heart of caramel, lavender and jasmine follows, and leather, patchouli and sandalwood give it depth. It is a sweet, flirty, grown-up scent often compared to Gissah Akoya.

Top: Bergamot, Orange, Raspberry
Middle: Caramel, Lavender, Jasmine
Base: Leather, Patchouli, Sandalwood, Woody Notes
